xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4943: Agent MCP and bots (W-PR1): Link and watch pull requests

plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-PR1): Link and watch pull requests
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Managed agents get the Overdeck MCP server with a scoped agent token (W-TOK1, W-MCP1, W-INJ1), but they cannot link a pull request to a conversation (the six PR-link routes have no scope rows, so every agent token gets 403) and cannot be told when a PR they care about changes. Work agents, the main users, also have no conversation row, so the epic's link-first watch design would fail for them.
narratives.Proposal: Add scope rows for the six existing PR-link routes; add a link_pull_request tool that targets a named conversation or, for an agent token, the caller's own conversation through POST /api/self/pull-requests. Add a cross-process JSON watch store (~/.overdeck/pr-watches.json, 0600, file lock) whose rows carry their own baseline snapshot fields. Add three self routes and three agent-only tools to create, list and delete watches; the create route reads the PR once for the baseline and links it best-effort. At the end of the existing 60 s PR sync sweep, resolve each watched key's snapshot from this pass's listing/fallback rows or one gh pr view under the same pause gate and backoff, then a notifier compares each watch with its baseline, persists the new baseline under the lock, and delivers one message per change in-process (messageAgent for agents with a dedupKey, handleConversationMessage for conversations). Merged, closed or the 11th review-only wake ends a watch; revoking an agent token removes its watches; the notifier drops orphaned watches. Document it in configuration/mcp.mdx, docs/DASHBOARD-AUTH.md and features/conversations.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Watching GitLab merge requests (GitHub PR URLs only).
- Watches on linked machines or fleet forwarding of the watch routes; a watch lives on this machine only.
- Any new timer, interval, service or per-watch poller; watched keys are read only inside runPullRequestSyncOnce.
- Changing how PR links are refreshed (isDue, the 15-minute slow lane, the 100-row listing cap).
- Hooking refreshPullRequestLinkNow or the link/sync routes into the notifier.
- Grouping uncovered watched keys into extra gh pr list calls.
- Instruction-block text for agents (W-INJ4, PAN-4935) and the epic-wide docs pass (W-DOC, PAN-4958).
- Retrying a failed delivery or resuming a stopped harness to deliver a watch message.
- A dashboard UI for watches.
- A tool for the reverse-index route beyond its scope row.
- Creating conversation rows for work agents.

autoDecisions.summary: Watches do not depend on PR links; watched keys are read inside the existing sweep (one gh pr view per uncovered key, same pause gate and 3-strike backoff).
autoDecisions.rationale: Work agents have no conversation row (spawn.ts:259; live DB shows agent-pan-4936 has none), and the sweep reads only linked PRs, so a link-gated watch would never fire for the issue's main user. Reading inside runPullRequestSyncOnce adds no timer or cadence, which is what FR-9 forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: Each watch stores its own baseline {state, checks, reviewState, mergeable}, read once when the watch is created; the epic's (key, before, after) hook at two call sites is replaced by one watch pass at sweep end.
autoDecisions.rationale: setPullRequestLinkSnapshot writes every link to a key, so link.snapshot is not one well-defined 'before', and unlinked PRs have none; a creation-time baseline closes the gap where a failure between creation and the first sweep would be absorbed silently.

autoDecisions.summary: Deliver in-process (messageAgent with dedupKey for agents, handleConversationMessage for conversations) instead of a loopback fetch with the internal token.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those are the doors the two message routes call; the conversation schedule service and review-verdict feedback already deliver this way from the same dashboard process.

autoDecisions.summary: Cap watches at 20 per owner (epic) and 50 in total.
autoDecisions.rationale: 50 uncovered keys cost at most 3,000 GraphQL points an hour, inside the 5,000-point user bucket; the PAN-4264 pause is the backstop.

autoDecisions.summary: The 11th consecutive review-only wake ends the watch (wakes 1-10 notify only).
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic's W-PR1 test list says 'the 11th quiet wake ends it'.

autoDecisions.summary: link_pull_request takes ref (URL, #42 or owner/repo#42) and defaults the target through a new self route POST /api/self/pull-requests.
autoDecisions.rationale: The existing route body is { ref, source? }, and McpToolContext carries no caller name, so only a self route can resolve 'my own conversation'.

autoDecisions.summary: Documentation ships in this issue (mcp.mdx, DASHBOARD-AUTH.md, conversations.mdx), not deferred to W-DOC.
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo rule: documentation is a required work item of every change.

Build the PR watch notifier: compare with baseline, persist, deliver

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint complete without errors
metadata.acJustification: Six criteria: the notifier carries the exactly-once, end-rule, orphan and delivery-door behaviors that the sweep and routes depend on; splitting them would separate the compare and persist halves of one locked update.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 with decisions D-2 to D-7 and D-13. New src/dashboard/server/services/pull-request-watch-notifier.ts exporting: pure watchWake(watch, snapshot) returning { events, last, quietWakes, ends, text } (event order merged, closed, checks-failed, checks-passed, conflicting, review-changed; mergeable baseline keeps the last non-null value; a move to pending updates last.checks without an event; text format '[Overdeck] <repository>#<number>: <phrase>; <phrase>. <url>' plus ' The watch has ended.' for merged/closed or the quiet-limit sentence; MAX_QUIET_WAKES = 10, a checks event resets quietWakes to 0, a review-only wake adds 1, quietWakes 11 ends the watch); listWatchedPullRequestKeys(); notifyPullRequestWatches(snapshots: ReadonlyMap<keyString, PullRequestSnapshot>, deps) which returns zeros without calling listActiveOwners when the store is empty, otherwise drops orphan watches (owner key not among active kind 'token' records with that agentId/agentKind and no revokedAt), applies watchWake in one updatePullRequestWatches call (incrementing wakes, removing ending watches), and only after the write delivers each message: agents via messageAgent(agentId, text, 'pr-watch', { dedupKey: 'pr-watch:<id>:<wakes>' }) counting delivered || queuedToMail as success; conversations via getConversationByName (a superseded /clear row resolves to its chain head with isSupersededConversation + resolveClearChainHead, as fireScheduledPrompt does at conversation-schedule-service.ts:118-123) + handleConversationMessage(name, { message, deliverAs: 'follow_up' for Pi harnesses }, { resolveSessionFile, generateAiTitle: async () => {} }). Never resume a harness; log '[pr-watch] delivery to <owner> failed: <reason>' and do not retry. Deps (listActiveOwners, deliverToAgent, deliverToConversation) are injectable. Tests per PRD WI-4.

items.title: Given a watch with last.checks pending, when notifyPullRequestWatches gets a red snapshot, then exactly one message is delivered with text '[Overdeck] eltmon/overdeck#7: checks failed (was pending). https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/7', and the same red snapshot again delivers nothing
A snapshot carrying red checks and a new reviewState produces one message naming both phrases, and an agent delivery receives dedupKey 'pr-watch:<id>:1'

Given an open watch, when the snapshot turns merged, then the notifier sends one message ending ' The watch has ended.' and deletes the watch; the 11th consecutive review-only wake sends and deletes the watch while the 10th preserves it
A watch whose owner has no active agent token is dropped with no delivery, and an empty store returns zeros without calling listActiveOwners
Given a conversation owner whose row is a superseded /clear row, the message is delivered to the chain head's name returned by resolveClearChainHead
When a delivery throws, the notifier logs one '[pr-watch] delivery to' line and the store still holds the new baseline (persist before deliver)
